name: split the region where the variance is largest and allocate samples in proportion
mechanism: spend a few samples estimating the variance of the integrand in each half of the region along each axis, split along the axis that most reduces total variance, give each half a share of the remaining samples proportional to its estimated spread, and recurse until the budget is small

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'MISER algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Numerical integration: Monte Carlo simulation, numerical integration

requires: a minimum sample budget per leaf (policy)
fails_when: variance estimates from few samples misdirect the split
